purpose: Windows local demo evaluation; AI runtime can later move to macOS
outputMode: json with server-side closed action validation

flowiseAttempt.initialFailureReason: better-sqlite3 native build: Windows SDK missing

modelRouting.missingRetrieval: Free-only Gemini if server verifies the key's project has no billing; otherwise local Qwen3 14B. No verified evidence means a read-only general-knowledge answer.

freeOnlyPolicy.generationRequires: Fresh Google API Keys lookup and Cloud Billing verification that the actual key's project has billing disabled and no attached billing account
freeOnlyPolicy.verificationAuthentication: Refreshable Google authorized_user OAuth credentials in ignored, access-restricted local server configuration
freeOnlyPolicy.currentRemoteGeneration: enabled only after fresh key-project and billing-disabled verification
freeOnlyPolicy.currentFallback: installed loopback-only Qwen3 14B when free eligibility, quota or provider is unavailable
freeOnlyPolicy.localCloudModels: blocked by name and installed GGUF metadata validation

map.coordinateSources: VisitJeju, Korea Tourism Organization, Seongdong District
map.lines: Validated OSRM car-road geometry when available; otherwise visit order with straight-line distance and no travel minutes
map.crossDayLegs: The last located stop of each DAY connects to the next DAY's first located stop, with an explicit date-transition label
map.viewInteractions: Local state only: map filters, collapse, pin selection and detailed DAY changes do not add messages or save itinerary edits
map.style: Spotlog coral road lines and numbered pins, 245px map and a non-GPS direction guide

routing.validation: Canonical landmark coordinates, waypoint and geometry order, leg count, distance and duration consistency, and snapped-coordinate straight-line lower bounds
routing.unlocatedStops: Never invent coordinates; totals and legs explicitly exclude intermediate unlocated visits and do not claim the complete actual journey

weather.purpose: development live model-based current weather and 7-day forecast
weather.standaloneAnswer: Validated tool measurements rendered directly without an LLM rewrite; existing itinerary, selected day and map remain available
weather.requestedRanges: Explicit one-to-seven-day ranges in Korea time; unsupported ranges are never silently reduced to today
weather.combinedItinerary: Model-selected grounded visits plus independently rendered verified weather measurements

itinerary.explicitMorningAfternoon: Require two fresh grounded visits per day; a directly named full-day place retains a disclosed single-place exception
itinerary.nearbyGrouping: Only an explicit unconstrained new-build request may regroup the same retrieved places by official representative-coordinate straight-line distance; fixed days, ordering and reservations are protected
